Yescool A2 User’sManual
3
 Appearance ⑴ Power：ON/recording、OFF/save ⑵ Microphone：Audio in ⑶ **LINE OUT** jack：Line out、reset（press the reset button when the recorder shut down） ⑷ **‘+’button：Next,** long press for volume up（short press to open REC indicator during recording） ⑸ **‘–‘Button：Previous,** long press for volume down （short press to turn off the indicator during recording）
![image](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
![image](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
Yescool A2 User’sManual
4
⑹ Indicator：REC indicator ⑺ USB port： Charging and data transfer ⑻ Back clip ⑼ Combined buttons：Hold “+”and”-“ at the same time to switch between music and recording file  Turn on /Turn offTurn on：Switch power button to “ON”, then the recorder is turned on and start to record automatically Turn Off：When the recorder is turned on , switch the power button across from “ON”
 Indicator 1、 Playback recording file : Blue indicator flashes2、 Playback music：Blue indicator flashes 3、 Recording：Red indicator flashes 4、 Charging：Blue indicator and red indicator light（Indicator turns off
when charging finish ） 5、 Low power：indicator flashes from blue to red  One click recording 1. Start recording：When the recorder is off, switch power button to ”ON“ to start recording directly. The red light is always flashing during recording.
![image](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
Yescool A2 User’sManual
5
2. Turn on / Turn off REC indicator: During recording, slide “-“ to turn off recording indicator , slide “+” to turn it . 3. Save recording file : There are two ways for saving files： （1） Under recording status , when you switch the power button from “ON” to the other side (“OFF”) , it can save the recording file and will turnoff automatically . （2）Under recording status , plug earbuds into the line out jack , the recording file can be saved and the recording file will play automatically .  Playback 1. Playback the recording file: Put the earphone into the line out jack, then switch the power button to “ON”, the recorder will playback the recording file automatically. And the blue indicator flashes. 2. Playback music：Put the earphone into the line out jack firstly , then switch the power button to “ON”，the recording file will playback automatically at this time . Then hold “+”and“-”button for 3 seconds, it will playback music. And the blue light will flash.  Skip music track During playback，Press “+” button or “-” button to skip one song to another .  Switch playback of music and recording fileDuring playback，holding “+” button and “-” button for 3 seconds at the same time can switch playback of recording file to music files .
![image](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
Yescool A2 User’sManual
6
 Volume up/down During playback, long press “+” button is volume up, long press “-” is volume down  Voice activationDuring recording，holding “+” button for 3 seconds and release to start voice activation . Holding“-”button for 3 seconds and release to turn offvoice activation .（When voice activation is pause, the blue light is on. When the blue indicator turns off and the red indicator flashes, voice activation will turn on and start recording).
 Time synchronization system Connect the recorder with a computer，choose the“ time correction tool“ at the removable disk as following：
Then switch the power button to “ON”，open the “time correction tool“ and click “Set Time”. When it shows “ success”, you can remove the USB from the computer . Make sure to keep the switch at “ON” for 10 seconds , and then turn off the recorder .
 Connect with a computer
![image](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
![image](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
Yescool A2 User’sManual
7
Connect the recorder to a computer by a USB cable.Please remove the disk in a right way, in order to avoid losing data.The recording files are saved in “RECORD” folderNote： If the recording file is more than 2GB, the extra information will be saved in another new file automatically.  Recharge
Connect the recorder with a power source (a PC or power bank) by a USB cable. When you see the blue light and the red light on, it is on charging. It takes about 2 hours to fully charge. The blue light and red light will be off when charging complete.
